raw.query: WITH cell_best AS (SELECT variate, resolution, mode, model, MIN(wape) AS best_wape FROM forecast_metrics GROUP BY variate, resolution, mode, model) SELECT c.variate, c.resolution, MIN(CASE WHEN c.model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto') THEN c.best_wape END) AS best_fm_wape, MIN(CASE WHEN c.model IN ('ewma','holt_winters','naive') THEN c.best_wape END) AS best_baseline_wape, CASE WHEN MIN(CASE WHEN c.model IN ('ewma','holt_winters','naive') THEN c.best_wape END) < MIN(CASE WHEN c.model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto') THEN c.best_wape END) THEN 'BASELINE_WINS' ELSE 'FM_WINS' END AS outcome FROM cell_best c GROUP BY c.variate, c.resolution ORDER BY outcome, c.variate, c.resolution;
raw.observed: 20 cells (4 variates × 5 resolutions): 18 FM_WINS, 2 BASELINE_WINS — ctx/1min (ewma 0.3827 < toto 0.3848) and images/1min (ewma 0.4793 < timesfm 0.4826)
raw.evidence: EWMA beats every foundation model in 2 of 20 cells (ctx/1min and images/1min, uni mode), so 'FM beat every baseline in all twenty cells' is false.
